svg.title: Pelorus Core + Stream sample topology — 40 ft sailing yacht
svg.desc: One C0 dual-bus helm zone, single-bus C2 zone, Stream over Ethernet bridged by a Class D standard gateway.
svg.text: Rest of vessel — single-bus (Bus A only), C2
